speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing right groin pain and have difficulty moving your leg following a rear-end collision. To ensure your safety and determine the correct treatment, I need to ask a few specific questions about your injury. 

First, can you describe exactly how your leg is currently positioned compared to the other side, and did you hear or feel a "pop" at the moment of impact?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Dislocation of the Right Femoral Head (Hip).
